My Salutations to all Pious Souls....

All of you are being informed that on Wednesday, 5-10-2022 collective Dussehra Meditation has been organised from 10 to 10.30 in the morning. You may participate in this from wherever you are.

On the auspicious day of Dussehra, the construction work of the Shree Guru Shakti Dham, Goa Ashram is going to commence. On that day, the programme of Modak Havan has also been kept.

Lots of blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
30|9|2022
